title: skills
summary: Benilla's one skill verb: CMSG_UNLEARN_SKILL (u32 skill line id), offered only where SkillRaceClassInfo flags carry SKILL_FLAG_UNLEARNABLE (0x20), removal returning via PLAYER_SKILL_INFO field updates. MSUI mirrors it exactly: WorldSession.UnlearnSkill sends the u32 body, Program.SkillFrame.cs gates the abandon on Formats/SkillLineCatalog's unlearnable predicate and never removes optimistically.
